name: rich-text-editor
title: Rich text editor
description: A field for notes, emails and briefs with headings, lists, links and @mentions, its value in markdown.

RichTextEditorRoot.description: The engine and the value, with no look of its own: a `div` (`data-slot="rich-text-editor"`) that holds the parts. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `div`.

props.name: value
props.description: The document (controlled). Markdown or JSON, by `format`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The document to start with (uncontrolled).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Each edit that changes the value, with the mentions in it. Never on mount, never for a selection change.

props.name: format
props.description: `'markdown'` (default) or `'json'` (Lexical's serialized editor state).

props.name: id
props.description: The editable area's id. A FormField's id, or generated, when left out.

props.name: labelledBy
props.description: The id of what names the editable area. A FormField's label when left out.

props.name: describedBy
props.description: Ids added to the editable area's `aria-describedby`, after a FormField's.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown in the empty editor, and its `aria-placeholder`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Not editable, out of the tab order, at 60%. A FormField's or Form's when left out.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Not editable, still focusable and selectable.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the editor invalid. A FormField's error sets it too.

props.name: name
props.description: Names a hidden input that carries the value in a native form submit. A FormField's `name` when left out.

props.name: editorRef
props.description: The editor's handle: focus, insert, insertText, getValue, getSelectionRect.

props.name: mentions
props.description: The `@` menu: `search` answers the text typed after the trigger. A pick goes in as a mention ("@Tara Mendes", one unit) followed by a space.

props.name: commands
props.description: The `/` menu: a pick takes "/query" out of the text and runs the command there.

RichTextEditorContent.description: The field (`.satin-field`, Textarea's skin) with the editable area in it (`data-slot="rich-text-editor-content"`, `role="textbox"`), the placeholder and the resize grip. `className` and the field's other props go to the field; `id`, `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby` and `autoFocus` to the editable area.

props.name: children
props.description: Drawn inside the field, before the editable area: where `RichTextToolbar` goes.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the editor on mount.

props.name: data-force
props.description: Show a state without interacting, for state sheets.

RichTextFormatToggle.description: A toolbar toggle for a mark (bold, italic, strikethrough, inline code): pressed while the selection has it, with the mark's icon, name and shortcut. For a toolbar of your own inside `RichTextToolbar` or `RichTextSelectionToolbar`. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `button`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Replaces the mark's own icon.

props.name: label
props.description: Replaces the mark's own name (from SatinLabels).

RichTextBlockToggle.description: A toolbar toggle for a bullet list, a numbered list or a quote: pressed while the selection is in one, and pressed again it turns the blocks back into paragraphs. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `button`.

RichTextLinkButton.description: A toolbar toggle that opens the link popover (as ⌘K does): pressed while the selection is in a link. Other props, `ref` included, go to the `button`.

RichTextBlockTypeMenu.description: The text style menu: a toolbar button that shows the current style (Paragraph, Heading 1–3) and opens a menu of them as radio items. A list or a quote shows Paragraph with nothing checked. Other props, `ref` included, go to the button.

RichTextToolbar.description: The formatting toolbar, inside the field above the text (`RichTextEditorContent`'s children), a subtle rule under it. Free's `Toolbar` with `preventFocusOnPress`, so a press keeps the selection; one tab stop, ← → between items, ⌥F10 from the text reaches its first item and Escape goes back to the text. Hidden when read-only; its items are disabled with the editor. `children` replace the preset: build one from `RichTextBlockTypeMenu`, `RichTextFormatToggle`, `RichTextBlockToggle`, `RichTextLinkButton` and Free's `ToolbarSeparator`, `ToolbarButton`. Other props, `ref` included, go to the toolbar `div`.

props.name: preset
props.description: `'default'`: text style | bold, italic, strikethrough, code | bullet list, numbered list, quote | link. `'minimal'`: bold, italic | bullet list | link. `children` replace either.

RichTextSelectionToolbar.description: The bubble over a selection: Free's `Toolbar variant="floating"` in a Radix Popover layer (non-modal) above the selected text, so inside a modal Dialog it takes presses and Escape reaches it first. It shows after a pointer selection (on release) or a double click, never for a selection made with the keyboard; it follows a selection changed while it's up, and goes with a collapsed selection, Escape, or focus leaving the text and the bubble. It doesn't take focus or sit in the tab order: ⌥F10 in the text reaches it when there's no fixed toolbar (and opens it on the caret), and Escape in it goes back to the text with the selection. `children` replace bold, italic, strikethrough and link; `actions` add to them after a separator. That's the place for actions on the selected text (an AI rewrite, a comment): any Toolbar item, with `editorRef`'s `getSelectionRect`, `insert` and `insertText` to act. Not drawn when the editor is read-only or disabled. Other props go to the toolbar `div`.

props.name: children
props.description: Replaces the default items (bold, italic, strikethrough, link).

props.name: actions
props.description: Added after the items, past a separator: actions on the selection (rewrite, translate, comment). They get the same context as the formatting items.

RichTextEditor.description: The editor for the common case: `RichTextEditorRoot` and `RichTextEditorContent` with a label, the formatting toolbar, the selection bubble, the hint or the error, and the status row. Other props, `ref` included, go to the root `div`.

props.name: optional
props.description: Adds a muted "(Optional)" after the label: the `optional` label.

props.name: error
props.description: An error message (replaces the hint), or `true` to mark the editor invalid without one.

props.name: status
props.description: Under the field on the right, like Textarea's counter: "Saved", a count of your own.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Shows a `length/maxLength` count of the text (not the markdown) in the status slot. Not enforced.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the editor on mount.

props.name: fieldClassName
props.description: Classes for the field (the edge and the editable area). `className` styles the outer wrapper.

props.name: toolbar
props.description: The formatting toolbar inside the field: `true` (default: text style, marks, lists, quote, link), `'minimal'` (bold, italic, bullet list, link) or `false`. Never drawn read-only.

props.name: selectionToolbar
props.description: The bubble over a pointer selection (bold, italic, strikethrough, link). On by default; never read-only.

props.name: data-force
props.description: Show a state without interacting, for state sheets.
